name: BCH Camp (Barbara C. Harris Camp)
operator_name: Barbara C. Harris Camp & Conference Center (Episcopal Diocese of Massachusetts)
description_short: Episcopal overnight camp on Otter Lake in Greenfield, NH, with a Mini Camp for kids who have completed K to 3rd grade, three youth weeks and a High School Camp for 9th to 12th graders. Campers boat, swim in the lake, do archery, basketball, arts and crafts and the challenge course, with chapel and worship each day.
activities: Rock Out Sesh talent show and dance party
refund_policy_summary: Every registration needs a $250 deposit that is not refunded. Cancel 30 or more days ahead and all other fees are refunded or moved to another week; cancel within 30 days and nothing is refunded, except for illness or a family emergency requested in writing.
special_needs_notes: The page has an inclusion statement saying people of all abilities are welcome. It does not describe any specific accommodations.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim in Otter Lake and go boating from the camp waterfront. The camp's pages don't describe swim tests or lifeguarding.
